insights.label: Heavy rain dilutes the chlorine
insights.advice: Test after a wet week and top the chlorine up.

tasks.title: Test the water (strips)
tasks.detail: Dip a test strip and log the results here.

tasks.title: Add chlorine (1/2 cup)
tasks.detail: Half a cup granular, poured by the pump return.

tasks.title: Robot vacuum
tasks.detail: Filter first, then run the robot.

tasks.title: Check & clean the basket
tasks.detail: Clean the strainer basket when you see debris.

tasks.title: Check pump flow / backwash
tasks.detail: Backwash if the pump seems weak.

opening.title: Spring opening
steps: Remove and clean the cover; let it dry before storing.
Reconnect the pump & filter; check the baskets.
Balance alkalinity, then pH, then chlorine.

closing.title: Fall closing (before the leaves fall)
steps: Put the cover on before the leaves start dropping.

waterLevel.note: Keep between the lowest and highest side screws.
